key.name: layout-json
key.description: Stores widget types, sizes, and desktop positions as JSON.

key.name: toggle-gallery
key.description: Global keyboard shortcut used to show or hide the widget gallery. An empty array disables the shortcut.

key.name: edge-launcher-enabled
key.description: Show the widget gallery button in the GNOME top panel.

key.name: digitalclock-hour-format
key.description: Use a 12-hour or 24-hour format in the Digital Clock widget.

key.name: digitalclock-show-seconds
key.summary: Show seconds in the digital clock
key.description: Display seconds when supported by the selected Digital Clock widget size.

key.name: digitalclock-show-ampm
key.summary: Show AM/PM in the digital clock
key.description: Display the AM/PM indicator when the Digital Clock uses the 12-hour format.

key.name: github-username
key.description: Public GitHub profile used by all GitHub Activity widgets.

key.name: github-use-green
key.description: Use GitHub contribution colors instead of the system accent color.

key.name: music-ignore-browsers
key.description: Prevent browser media sessions from taking over the Music widget.

key.name: music-blurred-background
key.description: Show an enlarged, dimmed, and tinted version of the current album artwork behind Music controls.

key.name: hide-system-media-controls
key.description: Hide GNOME Shell's built-in MPRIS cards while this extension is enabled.

key.name: screentime-retention-days
key.description: Number of days of local per-application Screen Time history to retain.

key.name: weather-location
key.description: City name used by the Weather widget. Searched via the Open-Meteo geocoding API.

key.name: style-border-radius
key.description: Corner radius of widgets in pixels.

key.name: style-background-blur
key.description: Make widget surfaces semi-transparent and blur the wallpaper behind them.

key.name: style-surface-default-migrated
key.description: Tracks migration to solid widget surfaces by default.
